name: Strategy handoff drafts first content (circuit A to B)
description: Locking a strategy session via handoff creates a campaign and drafts the first cross-channel content, returning the new campaign's board; the session is then linked to that campaign.

planSteps.description: GET {base_url}/api/v1/team/members and capture a lead member id for the X-Member-Id header used on all subsequent requests.

POST {base_url}/api/v1/team/strategy/sessions with the lead X-Member-Id header and JSON body {"inputs":[{"type":"idea","value":"An AI tool that verifies AI-generated code before teams ship it."}]}, then capture the returned session id.
POST {base_url}/api/v1/team/strategy/sessions/{session_id}/handoff with the lead X-Member-Id header and JSON body {"audience_index":0,"angle_index":0}.

Verify the response is 200 and returns a board object with a 'campaign' (having a non-empty id and name), a 'tasks' array containing at least one task, and a non-empty 'members' array. Capture the campaign id.
GET {base_url}/api/v1/team/strategy/sessions/{session_id} with the lead X-Member-Id header.
Verify the response is 200 and the session's 'campaign_id' now equals the captured campaign id (the session is linked to the new campaign).
